integrity: All infinite-dimensional conclusions are established by the written argument; finite computational tests are supplementary. Originality is provisional pending independent historical-priority assessment.
scientific_limitations: Unit disk only; harmonic Bergman probability weights with fixed alpha > -1.
Integer positive angular winding only; no finite-data noise stability or uniformity in alpha.
Fixed-winding harmonic Toeplitz mode formulas predate the present work; only growing-winding spectral and loss laws are advanced.
Earlier literature may contain an equivalent asymptotic theorem, and one 2014 quasihomogeneous harmonic paper was not read in full.
title: Winding-scale spectral law for harmonic Bergman projection leakage
